question: What is the leading cause of death in India?
solution:
The correct answer is** "Heart diseases."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us explore the last sentence of the second paragraph:
 
 
• *"Heart disease has been one of the leading causes of death in India for over two decades, along with an increasing propensity for cancer and diabetes."*
 
 
 
• Heart diseases are the leading cause of death in India.
